notes.title: 2.06 New Map, New tile, improved AI
notes.content:
New Map: Elven Fortificaiton

 Snow theme
 Elves start strong in a fortified position
 Four hills with new tile type: Elevated terrain
 No resource camps are present so building camps are required to gain more resources


New tile type: Elevated Terrain

 +1 Range to ranged units
 Line of sight cannot be blocked beside Elevated Tile. E.g: A wall beside elevated tile can be shot over


Improved AI
AI will now be more aggressive and prioritize fighting

notes.title: 2.05 Lighting intensity and low settings performance
notes.content:
Reduced background lighting intensity on T5 systems
 Increased performance for Low setting on T5 system to allow the game to run smoothly with multiple glasses on lower end devices

notes.title: 2.04 Multiple Save Support
notes.content:
Multiple saves is now supported. Game will auto-save after each turn and each session will be saved separately and can be loaded from the Load menu.
 Reduced Bloom effect

notes.title: 2.03 Small bug fix
notes.content: Buildings can no longer be healed. Healing a town caused a bug that caused game state to freeze.

notes.title: 2.01 Bug Fixes
notes.content: Fixed issue where auto surrender of player or AI would cause game to hang

notes.title: New Map: Desert Oasis
notes.content:
Desert Oasis

 62% Larger map to fight epic battles and outmanoeuvre your opponent!
 Safe starting fortress so you are never completely out of the match
 Gain extra resources by building camps at the oasis 


Tilt Five
Added Zoom feature by pressing button 1 (in) 2 (out).
Bug Fixes

 Improved AI decision performance
 Fixed issue where AI sometimes would not build in their building action

notes.title: 1.94 Minor UI and Balance changes
notes.content:
Resource and Menu Panel moved to bottom of screen
 Human now consume all movement points when moving out of or onto a water tile
 Fixed issue where moveable tiles were not always highlighted correctly

notes.title: 1.94 Small UI and Balance changes
notes.content:
Resources and menu panel is now anchored to the bottom of the screen instead of top
 Humans now lose all movement points when moving in to or out of a water tile
 Fixed issue where movement highlighting was not updated at all times

notes.title: 1.91 Minor bug fixes
notes.content:
Fix mountain tiles close to giant spawn being both mountain and water tile
Fix falling sound when buildings are created on game start

notes.title: A Healthy Notification
notes.content:
Additions

 Resources on Town tiles and Treasury tile is now displayed on tooltip
 Healthbars added to all units and destructible buildings when hovering with mouse
 Diplomacy now usable at any time
 Victory Point categories removed: Largest Trade and Five Turn Alliance
 Automatic surrender if no possible moves are available
 Slightly adjusted all world UI's to be better angled towards the camera

Map Changes

 Each starting area now has access to at least one of each tile type: Forest, Ocean and Mountain so that they can build Resource Camps of all types

Balance Changes

 Catapult range reduced by 1 (4 now, previous 5)
 Bra'Telu's (Elf Hero) Ranged reduced by 1 (3 now, previous 4) and damage increased by 25%
 Town Max Resource Capacity increased by 50 (400 now, previous 350)
 Town minimum distance to closest town requirement reduced by 1 (3 now, previous 4)

Bug Fixes

 When a race surrenders all owned resource camps will now become neutral
 Victory points awarded to a surrendered race is now visible in VP details window
 Building towns no longer highlights unavailable tiles


Big thanks to my loyal testers for coming with feedback and idea
Anton
Bergys
Bratel
Dave
Lamsa
Ludvig

notes.title: The Fog Is Clearing
notes.content:
- Gameplay Flow
    * Changing selected Action is now possible
    * Actions that have no effect will be disabled (I.E Hero ability out of range)
    * Added UI information when another player is selecting their action
    * Recruiting and Building can now be performed by pressing the wanted unit and then selecting a tile
       or selecting a tile and then selecting unit as before
    * After selecting a building to build, all the possible tiles for that building type will be lit
    * Unit type Icon was added above armies that are on a forest, ocean or mountain tile to make them 
       easier to spot

- Added mouseover tooltip to most UI elements and buildings in the game to help guide new players
- Slightly changed Human spawning location from user feedback

- Bugfixes
    * Fixed an issue where Orcs and Giants could get to perform their actions simultaneously
    * Fixed lighting in Elven corner which caused headaches and eye strain
    * Fixed scroll speed on several scroll views
    * Lowered default sound volume
    * Fixed wasd/arrow camera movement not working when having mouse over UI
    * Fixed missing material in Undead Raise Dead ability (pink particle)

notes.title: Version 1.81
notes.content:
- Updated enemy AI to strive after getting more Victory Points. AI will now try to capture carts, pick up Fire Stones and Produce Fire Stones when controlling the Center
- Added a simple guide to help new players understand the goal of the game
- Added a simple Controls Sheet

- Bug fixes
    * Fixed an issue where picking up Fire Stones could cause the game to lock up and become slow
